RBA flags rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate-cut path (18)

Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, pressuring financials (61)
High-end property sees steepest falls while affordable segment holds (62, 47)
Iron ore weakness spreads, pressuring BHP/RIO/FMG (78)

Queensland near credit-rating downgrade, raising sovereign risk (31)

sectors.trend: Iron ore weakness spreads (78) dragging BHP, RIO, FMG lower; however WA gold exploration is active with multiple high-grade hits (42, 71-74) and copper stakes rising on red-metal strength (68). Mixed but net negative for large-cap miners.
sectors.implications: Large-cap iron ore names under pressure; small/mid-cap gold explorers (Gateway, Auric, Golden Dragon, Patriot) attract speculative flows. Diversify away from pure iron ore exposure.

sectors.trend: Banks sell off alongside miners as bond yields rise (32). Bathla's collapse ripples through private credit (61), raising systemic concerns. Woolworths price-hike controversy (15) pressures consumer lending sentiment.
sectors.implications: CBA, NAB, ANZ, WBC face margin pressure from yield volatility and credit-risk repricing. Private credit exposure is a new tail risk.

sectors.trend: Oil at $100 triggers global risk-off (57, 28). Australia softens gas reservation rules (40, 54), supporting Woodside/Santos. Data-centre power demand at coal sites (66, 77) creates structural energy demand but strains transition narrative.
sectors.implications: WDS, STO benefit from gas policy shift. Coal-to-data-centre pivot (66) is a medium-term theme for energy majors.

sectors.trend: Woolworths caught raising 'family staple' prices during Price Freeze (15), damaging brand trust. Chinese inflation surge (48) may lift import costs. Consumer sentiment fragile.
sectors.implications: WES, WOW face margin and reputational pressure. Monitor CPI data (1) for pass-through effects.

sectors.trend: High-end property sees steepest falls while affordable segment resilient (62). Leith Van Onselen warns of biggest housing price fall (47). NSW stamp-duty hit pressures state budgets (55). RBA rental inflation concern (18) supports residential REITs.
sectors.implications: Residential REITs (e.g., GPT, ICPS) may benefit from rental demand; commercial REITs face headwinds. NSW fiscal stress is a watch item.

sectors.trend: AI data-centre buildout at coal sites (66) and Critical Resources battery tech validation (41) support tech-adjacent plays. Kiniksa revenue beat (14) positive for CSL-adjacent biotech sentiment.
sectors.implications: CSL remains defensive anchor. Battery-tech and data-centre infrastructure names gain thematic interest.

RBA caught between rental inflation and growth concerns; CPI data is pivotal (18, 1)
Gas policy liberalisation reshapes Australian energy landscape (40, 54)
Private credit stress from Bathla collapse is a new systemic risk (61)
Housing bifurcation: luxury falls, affordable holds (62, 47)
WA gold exploration boom continues with multiple funding rounds (42, 71-74)
Chinese inflation surge threatens commodity demand outlook (48)
Data-centre power demand vs energy transition tension (66, 77)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil at $100 / rising bond yields triggering global risk-off
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce net equity beta; increase allocation to cash and short-duration bonds. Hedge commodity exposure.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy uncertainty amid rental inflation and thin CPI call
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid large directional bets pre-CPI release. Maintain balanced rate-sensitive portfolio.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Private credit contagion from Bathla collapse
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review bank exposure to private credit and structured products. Monitor CBA/NAB/ANZ/WBC credit provisions.
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold and copper names.
Reduce QLD-linked infrastructure and REIT exposure. Monitor state bond spreads.
Hedge AUD exposure for multinational earnings; monitor AUD/USD for commodity-linked moves.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1-3 months. $100 oil and rising bond yields (57, 28) sustain risk-off. CPI data (1) and RBA rental inflation stance (18) are the next catalysts. Iron ore weakness (78) keeps materials sector soft. Private credit stress (61) may trigger further financials volatility. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a range with downside bias until oil/yield stabilise.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook is cautiously constructive. Gas policy reform (40, 54) supports energy sector. WA gold pipeline (42, 71-74) and battery tech (41) offer structural growth. Housing bifurcation (62) suggests selective REIT opportunities. Data-centre power demand (66, 77) creates a multi-year energy infrastructure theme. Key risk: Chinese demand (48) and global rate path.
